name: agentic-web-stack
description: Reference architectures, protocols, standards, and technologies for the emerging Agentic Web.

scripts.api:dev: uv run --project services/api --locked uvicorn --app-dir services/api/src agentic_web_demo.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.api:test: uv run --project services/api --locked pytest -c services/api/pyproject.toml services/api/tests
scripts.check: npm run specs:validate && npm run api:test && npm run demo:smoke && npm run docs:build
